title: Target local PowerSync budget-category reference provider

surfaces.currentBehavior: Executable module-internal Account/Principal-bound BudgetCategoryReferenceQuerying PowerSync adapter over already-materialized local category rows with independently reactive completeness, membership-gated authority and no local visibility decision.
surfaces.notes: The previously verified provider remains behaviorally bounded to the already-materialized local subset. Exact Item-assignment implementation run 34029102593 exposed a pre-existing provider shutdown race: after an emitted snapshot, cancellation could leave the combined event loop suspended while its row and completeness sources remained open, so the macOS job timed out at the existing provider-drain test. The one-file reliability correction installs a cancellation handler that cancels both owned observers and finishes the internal event channel before the existing awaited cleanup. Two independent reviews found no P0-P3 code issue. Fourteen focused tests, 100 consecutive post-emission shutdown repetitions, 100 consecutive pre-completeness shutdown repetitions, and both normal and nonparallel 606-test suites pass locally. Exact synchronized correction CI remains pending, so this surface is implemented rather than re-verified. O-026 remains outside: this adapter consumes only the subset already present locally and neither decides visibility nor claims hidden counts.

securityRequirements: Exact Account binding and active local membership sentinel before emitting materialized rows
No local visibility_class, financial_access, role or hidden-count decision
Typed local scope is not fresh authorization or hosted completeness proof
syncRequirements: Independent query-specific completeness is false by default and cannot be inferred from cached rows or generic PowerSync sync metadata
Database rows and completeness remain independently reactive and cancellation drains both observations
Content-bound local versions preserve exact already-materialized category fields and readiness

migration.rule: Read only synthetic target-local category rows; decode no Firebase category preset or source export.
reconciliation: Visible count equals only the emitted local subset and never implies the number of server-hidden rows

acceptance: Exact local scope, row validation, ordering, readiness, restart and lifecycle behavior pass without final visibility or hosted authority claims
